comments.author: 100330886@N04
comments.text: In Arizona, with the right materials about 10 seconds (not exaggerating). In the Pacific Northwest or England a bit longer. The technique to look up is "Egyptian bow drill". It is a very easy technique and people seem to agree that it works well in more conditions for more people than other techniques like hand drill or traditional bow drill.
